senses.gloss: (b. h.) to draw, capture; to carry off.
units: Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVIII; Yalk. Gen. 134 שְׁלָלָהּ וכ׳ he (Shechem) carried her off and slept with her.—Trnsf. (of water) to make inroads.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 61a:15">B. Kam. 61ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שׁוֹלְלִין</he>, v. <cite ref="U01250"><he>שְׁלוּלִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Isaiah 59:15">Is. LIX, 15</cite>) <he>וסר מרע מִשְׁתּוֹלֵל על הבריות</he> he that departs from evil is considered by people as senseless.
